propositions: A completion close reads HEAD independently during verify and sign phases, allowing an unrelated commit to land in the window and cause verify and sign to operate on different revisions
When HEAD drifts between verify and sign, the ticket closes without a completion signature, leaving it in a permanently closed but unattested state with no non-force recovery path
The suggested recovery (re-close to certify) is a no-op because the ticket is already closed, and the only available recovery is --force-close or manual manifest fabrication
The root cause is that verify+sign+close treat the working tree as an ambient global instead of pinning a single revision for the entire atomic operation
The --ref workaround from 80af only fixed the non-default path; the default path (no --ref) still reads HEAD twice and remains vulnerable to splitting
